On <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> February&nbsp;</em><em data-td-fact-id="27727955" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">12,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27727956" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2018,</em> our Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of <em data-td-fact-id="27727957" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$0.15</em> per share of common stock aggregating approximately <em data-td-fact-id="27727958" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$6.1</em> million payable on <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> March&nbsp;</em><em data-td-fact-id="27727959" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">15,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27727960" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2018</em> to shareholders of record as of <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> March 1, 2018. </em>These quarterly cash dividends are being paid using available cash and cash equivalents on hand.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;"><b>Stock Repurchase Program</b><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"> &ndash; Our Board of Directors has approved a stock repurchase program authorizing SMI to repurchase up to an aggregate of <em data-td-fact-id="27727961" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">6,000,000</em> shares (increased from <em data-td-fact-id="27727962" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">5,000,000</em> shares with Board of Director approval on <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> February 12, 2018) </em>of our outstanding common stock from time to time, depending on market conditions, share price, applicable limitations under our debt agreements, and other factors the Board of Directors or its designees, in their sole discretion, <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>consider relevant. The purchases can be in the open market or private transactions. The stock repurchase program is presently funded using available cash and cash equivalents and <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>be suspended or discontinued at any time.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">We repurchased <em data-td-fact-id="27727963" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">251,000,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27727964" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">252,000</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27727965" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">252,000</em> shares of common stock for <em data-td-fact-id="27727966" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$5,015,</em><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"><em data-td-fact-id="27727967" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">000</em> in <em data-td-fact-id="27727968" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27727969" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$4,667,000</em> in <em data-td-fact-id="27727970" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27727971" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$5,375,000</em> in <em data-td-fact-id="27727972" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015,</em> respectively. As of <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017, </em>we could repurchase up to an additional <em data-td-fact-id="27727973" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">191,000</em> shares (<em data-td-fact-id="27727974" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">1,162,000</em> shares as of <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> February 12, 2018) </em>under authorization then in effect. In <em data-td-fact-id="27727975" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27727976" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27727977" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015,</em> we repurchased approximately <em data-td-fact-id="27727978" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">56,000,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27727979" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">58,000</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27727980" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">53,000</em> shares of common stock for <em data-td-fact-id="27727981" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$1,103,000,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27727982" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$1,169,000</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27727983" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$1,122,000</em> from management employees to settle income taxes on <em data-td-fact-id="27727984" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">139,000,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27727985" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">136,000</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27727986" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">125,000</em> restricted shares that vested during the periods, respectively.<b> </b>As of and through <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="27727987" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016,</em> treasury stock includes <em data-td-fact-id="27727988" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">328,000</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27727989" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">272,000</em> shares of common stock delivered to the Company for such purposes.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;"><b><em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">December 2017 </em>Tax Cuts and Jobs Act Enactment (Note <em data-td-fact-id="27727991" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2</em>)</b><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"> </font><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"><i>&ndash;</i> On <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 22, 2017, </em>the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act was enacted into United States tax law substantially amending the Internal Revenue Code. Effective <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> January 1, 2018, </em>the Act permanently reduces US corporate federal tax rates from <em data-td-fact-id="27727992" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">35%</em> to <em data-td-fact-id="27727993" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">21%,</em> provides for <em data-td-fact-id="27727994" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">100%</em> expensing of certain qualified capital investments through <em data-td-fact-id="27727995" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2022,</em> repeals the Alternative Minimum Tax, eliminates loss carrybacks, limits using future losses, and further limits the deductibility of certain executive compensation, among other provisions. Many effects of the Act are international in nature, and therefore do <em data-td-fact-id="27727996" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> apply us. Under current accounting guidance, we are recognizing the effects of the changed tax rates and laws as of the enactment date, subject to SAB <em data-td-fact-id="27727997" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">No.</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27727998" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">118</em> which provides for a provisional <em data-td-fact-id="27727999" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">one</em>-year measurement period for entities to finalize their accounting for certain income tax effects of the Tax Act. As further described in Note <em data-td-fact-id="27728000" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2,</em> SAB <em data-td-fact-id="27728001" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">No.118</em> addresses the application of US GAAP where entities do <em data-td-fact-id="27728002" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> have the necessary information available, prepared or analyzed (including computations) in reasonable detail to complete such accounting. </font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">As such, under SAB <em data-td-fact-id="27728003" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">No.</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27728004" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">118,</em> we recorded a provisional <em data-td-fact-id="27728005" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">one</em>-time material reduction of our net deferred income tax liabilities, and corresponding income tax <font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">benefit, of <em data-td-fact-id="27728006" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$119,449,000</em> in the <em data-td-fact-id="27728007" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">fourth</em> quarter <em data-td-fact-id="27728008" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017,</em> resulting from re-measuring our deferred tax assets and liabilities using the new lower tax rate and certain tax expense. The associated effects on our gross deferred tax assets, deferred tax liabilities and valuation allowances, including changes in timing differences, are reflected in the above disclosures. The reduction consists of</font>: (i) tax benefits of <em data-td-fact-id="27728009" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$120,172,000</em> using the new lower federal tax rates and (ii) provisional tax expense of <em data-td-fact-id="27728010" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$723,000</em> related to non-deductible executive compensation as we anticipate the performance-based exception on our cash compensation plans will <em data-td-fact-id="27728011" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> longer be applicable.&nbsp;<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">We anticipate the Internal Revenue Service will be providing additional guidance on the accounting for non-deductible executive compensation. We plan to finalize the accounting for those provisional amounts upon filing of our federal income tax returns within our <em data-td-fact-id="27728012" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2018</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27728013" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">fourth</em> quarter</font>&nbsp;or in earlier periods if additional guidance is issued<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">. Final amounts <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>differ from provisional amounts after further analysis, changes in interpretation and assumptions, or additional regulatory guidance that <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>be issued, among other things.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;"><b>Effective Tax Rate Comparison for <em data-td-fact-id="27728014" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015</em></b><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"> <b>through <em data-td-fact-id="27728015" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em></b> &ndash; Our effective income tax rate for <em data-td-fact-id="27728016" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> was <em data-td-fact-id="27728017" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">234.1%</em> (benefit), for <em data-td-fact-id="27728018" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> was <em data-td-fact-id="27728019" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">35.4%</em> (expense) and for <em data-td-fact-id="27728020" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015</em> was <em data-td-fact-id="27728021" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">25.7%</em> (expense). Our <em data-td-fact-id="27728022" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> effective tax rate reflects the <em data-td-fact-id="27728023" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">one</em>-time material tax benefit&nbsp;associated with re-measuring our deferred tax assets and liabilities using the new lower US corporate federal tax rate of <em data-td-fact-id="27728024" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">21%,</em> and tax expense of&nbsp;related to non-deductible executive compensation as further described above.&nbsp;The <em data-td-fact-id="27728025" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> rate also reflects non-recurring tax benefits of <em data-td-fact-id="27728026" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$575,000</em> resulting from certain state income tax law changes, and non-recurring tax benefits of <em data-td-fact-id="27728027" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$1,070,000</em> for lower state income tax rates associated with <em data-td-fact-id="27728028" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2018</em> race date realignments. Our <em data-td-fact-id="27728029" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> effective tax rate reflects non-recurring tax benefits of <em data-td-fact-id="27728030" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$546,000</em> resulting from certain state income tax law changes. Our <em data-td-fact-id="27728031" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015</em> tax rate reflects reductions of valuation allowances on deferred tax assets associated with our discontinued operation. Our <em data-td-fact-id="27728032" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015</em> tax rate also reflects lower effective state income tax rates, adjustments associated with the <em data-td-fact-id="27728033" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015</em> intangible asset and goodwill impairment charges and certain deferred tax assets, and a non-recurring tax benefit of <em data-td-fact-id="27728034" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$610,000</em> resulting from certain state income tax law changes enacted in <em data-td-fact-id="27728035" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015.</em></font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">At <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017, </em>the Company has approximately $<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"><em data-td-fact-id="27728036" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">205,082,000</em> of state net operating loss carryforwards expiring in <em data-td-fact-id="27728037" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2018</em> through <em data-td-fact-id="27728038" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2037.</em> At <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="27728039" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016,</em> valuation allowances of <em data-td-fact-id="27728040" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$1,940,000</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27728041" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$1,748,000</em> have been provided against deferred tax assets because management has determined that ultimate realization is <em data-td-fact-id="27728042" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> more likely than <em data-td-fact-id="27728043" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> for certain deferred tax assets and state net operating loss carryforwards. The valuation allowances for deferred tax assets increased by <em data-td-fact-id="27728044" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$192,000</em> in <em data-td-fact-id="27728045" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017,</em> increased by <em data-td-fact-id="27728046" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$326,000</em> in <em data-td-fact-id="27728047" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016,</em> and decreased by <em data-td-fact-id="27728048" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$10,771,000</em> in <em data-td-fact-id="27728049" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015.</em></font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;"><b>&nbsp;</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;"><b>Accounting for Uncertainty in Income Taxes</b><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"> &ndash; Income tax liabilities for unrecognized tax benefits approximate <em data-td-fact-id="27728050" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$11,711,000</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27728051" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$12,006,000</em> at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="27728052" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27728053" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$11,711,000</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27728054" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$11,746,000</em> of which relates to our discontinued operation. Of those amounts, <em data-td-fact-id="27728055" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$11,534,000</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27728056" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$11,794,000</em> is included in noncurrent other liabilities, all of which would favorably impact our effective tax rate if recognized, and <em data-td-fact-id="27728057" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$177,000</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27728058" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$212,000</em> is included in deferred tax liabilities, at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="27728059" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016,</em> respectively. As of <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="27728060" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016,</em> management believes <em data-td-fact-id="27728061" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$0</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27728062" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$260,000</em> of unrecognized tax benefits will be recognized within the next <em data-td-fact-id="27728063" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">twelve</em> months. Interest and penalties associated with uncertain tax benefits amounted to <em data-td-fact-id="27728064" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$188,000</em> in <em data-td-fact-id="27728065" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27728066" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$61,000</em> in <em data-td-fact-id="27728067" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27728068" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$15,000</em> in <em data-td-fact-id="27728069" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015,</em> and derecognized amounts were <em data-td-fact-id="27728070" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$86,000</em> in <em data-td-fact-id="27728071" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27728072" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$90,000</em> in <em data-td-fact-id="27728073" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27728074" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$174,000</em> in <em data-td-fact-id="27728075" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015.</em> As of <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="27728076" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016,</em> we had <em data-td-fact-id="27728077" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$241,000</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27728078" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$140,000</em> accrued for the payment of interest and penalties on uncertain tax positions, which is included in other noncurrent liabilities. The tax years that remain open to examination include <em data-td-fact-id="27728079" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015</em> through <em data-td-fact-id="27728080" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> by the Internal Revenue Service, and <em data-td-fact-id="27728081" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2013</em>&nbsp;through <em data-td-fact-id="27728082" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> by other&nbsp;state taxing jurisdictions to which we are subject.&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;"><b>Income Tax Benefits</b><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"> &ndash;&nbsp;Applicable accounting guidance <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>require establishing valuation allowances for certain deferred tax assets or income tax liabilities for unrecognized tax benefits, although management believes associated tax filing positions are sustainable and properly reflected in its tax filings. Our liabilities for unrecognized tax benefits are reflected in the table above. Should those tax positions <em data-td-fact-id="27728084" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> be fully sustained if examined, an acceleration of material income taxes payable could occur. Where <em data-td-fact-id="27728085" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> net income tax benefit had been previously reflected because of providing a valuation allowance on related deferred tax assets, our future results of operations might <em data-td-fact-id="27728086" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> be significantly impacted. However, resulting cash required for payments of income taxes could be material in the period in which such determination is made.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">The Company and Sonic Financial Corporation (Sonic Financial), a Company affiliate through common ownership by our Executive Chairman and our Chief Executive <font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">Officer, share various expenses in the ordinary course of business under a shared services agreement. We incurred expenses under the shared services agreement of <em data-td-fact-id="27728088" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$845,000</em> in <em data-td-fact-id="27728089" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27728090" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$930,000</em> in <em data-td-fact-id="27728091" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27728092" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$452,000</em> in <em data-td-fact-id="27728093" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015.</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27728094" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">No</em> amounts were due from or payable to Sonic Financial at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="27728095" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016.</em></font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">The Company and certain SMI subsidiaries lease office and warehouse facilities from companies affiliated through common ownership by our Executive Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, under annually renewa<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">ble lease agreements.</font><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"> Rent expense amounted to <em data-td-fact-id="27728096" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$721,000</em> in <em data-td-fact-id="27728097" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27728098" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$721,000</em> in <em data-td-fact-id="27728099" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27728100" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$698,000</em> in <em data-td-fact-id="27728101" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015.</em> Amounts owed to these affiliated companies at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December&nbsp;</em><em data-td-fact-id="27728102" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">31,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27728103" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27728104" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> were <em data-td-fact-id="27728105" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> significant.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">Various SMI subsidiaries purchased new and used vehicle<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">s for operations and employee use from certain subsidiary dealerships of Sonic Automotive, Inc. (SAI), an entity in which our Executive Chairman is a controlling stockholder, for an aggregate of approximately <em data-td-fact-id="27728106" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$238,000</em> in <em data-td-fact-id="27728107" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27728108" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$162,000</em> in <em data-td-fact-id="27728109" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27728110" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$120,000</em> in <em data-td-fact-id="27728111" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015.</em> Vehicles sold to SAI in <em data-td-fact-id="27728112" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27728113" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> or <em data-td-fact-id="27728114" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015</em> were <em data-td-fact-id="27728115" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> significant. Also, SMI sold through certain speedways and its SMIP merchandising subsidiary various event related inventory and merchandise to SAI totaling approximately <em data-td-fact-id="27728116" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$866,000</em> in <em data-td-fact-id="27728117" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27728118" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$937,000</em> in <em data-td-fact-id="27728119" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27728120" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$913,000</em> in <em data-td-fact-id="27728121" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015.</em> At <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="27728122" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27728123" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$70,000</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27728124" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$84,000</em> was due from SAI and is reflected in current assets.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">Oil-Chem sold zMAX micro-lubricant<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">&reg;</font><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"> product to certain SAI dealerships for resale to service customers of the dealerships in the ordinary course of business. Total purchases from Oil-Chem by SAI dealerships approximated <em data-td-fact-id="27728125" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$1,940,000</em> in <em data-td-fact-id="27728126" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27728127" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$2,054,000</em> in <em data-td-fact-id="27728128" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27728129" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$2,131,000</em> in <em data-td-fact-id="27728130" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015.</em> At <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December&nbsp;</em><em data-td-fact-id="27728131" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">31,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27728132" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27728133" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27728134" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$148,000</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27728135" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$194,000</em> was due from SAI and is reflected in current assets.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

We believe that the resolution of any or all <font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">of such litigation will <em data-td-fact-id="27728139" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> have a material effect on our financial condition, results of operations or cash flows.</font></p>

<div data-td-parse-id="1" data-td-statement-type="note" data-td-v2v-id="1520032391358" id="thunderdome-statement-805670">
<table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width:100%;text-indent:0;font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">

		<tr>
			<td style="vertical-align:top;width:3.3%;">
			<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:1.6pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;"><b><em data-td-fact-id="27728140" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">11.</em></b></p>
			</td>
			<td style="vertical-align:top;width:96.7%;">
			<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:0pt;margin-right:1.6pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;"><b>STOCK COMPENSATION PLANS</b></p>
			</td>
		</tr>

</table>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;"><b><em data-td-fact-id="27728141" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2013</em> Stock Incentive Plan, Amended and Restated as of <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> April 19, 2017 </em></b><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">&ndash; The <em data-td-fact-id="27728142" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2013</em> Stock Incentive Plan (the <em data-td-fact-id="27728143" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2013</em> Plan) allows the Company, among other things, to provide equity-based incentives to, and continue to attract and retain, key employees, directors and other individuals providing services to the Company. Awards under the <em data-td-fact-id="27728144" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2013</em> Plan <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>be in the form of incentive stock options, nonqualified stock options, stock appreciation rights (SARs), restricted stock, restricted stock units or stock awards. In <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> February 2017, </em>our Board of Directors adopted an amended and restated <em data-td-fact-id="27728145" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2013</em> Stock Incentive Plan which was approved by the stockholders on <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> April 19, 2017 </em>at the <em data-td-fact-id="27728146" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> Annual Meeting. The amendment and restatement did <em data-td-fact-id="27728147" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> increase the number of shares reserved for issuance or any of the award limits under the <em data-td-fact-id="27728148" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2013</em> Plan. The primary changes included: (i) additions to the permissible criteria upon which performance goals for performance-based compensation can be based; and (ii) revisions and additions to the types of items and events that <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>be used for adjustments in determining whether an objective performance goal for performance-based compensation has been met.&nbsp;To date, we have awarded restricted stock and restricted stock units under the <em data-td-fact-id="27728149" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2013</em> Plan.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">The <em data-td-fact-id="27728150" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2013</em> Plan is administered by the Compensation Committee of the Board of <font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">Directors who has full authority to determine recipients, types, purchase prices, and amounts of awards granted and amend the terms, restrictions and conditions of awards. Factors considered, among others, include achievement of financial, business and performance objectives, the occurrence of specific events, time periods of continued service or other time-based restrictions. Under the <em data-td-fact-id="27728151" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2013</em> Plan, <em data-td-fact-id="27728152" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">3,500,000</em> shares of SMI&rsquo;s common stock are reserved for issuance, subject to various restrictions and adjustments including the following: (i)&nbsp;if shares subject to award under the <em data-td-fact-id="27728153" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2013</em> Plan are forfeited, or the award otherwise terminates or is canceled for any reason without the issuance of such shares, those shares will be available for future awards; (ii)&nbsp;<em data-td-fact-id="27728154" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> individual <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>be granted options or SARs aggregating more than <em data-td-fact-id="27728155" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">300,000</em> shares of common stock during any calendar year; (iii)&nbsp;in the case of awards other than options or SARs that are intended to be &ldquo;performance-based compensation&rdquo;, <em data-td-fact-id="27728156" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> individual <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>be granted an aggregate of more than <em data-td-fact-id="27728157" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">100,000</em> shares of common stock during any calendar year; and (iv)&nbsp;with respect to any cash-based stock award that is intended to be a performance award, the maximum cash payment that <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>be paid during any <em data-td-fact-id="27728158" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">one</em> calendar year to an individual is <em data-td-fact-id="27728159" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$10,000,000.</em> Exercise prices for awarded stock options generally <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em><em data-td-fact-id="27728160" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> be less than the fair or trading value of the Company&rsquo;s common stock at, and exercise periods <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em><em data-td-fact-id="27728161" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> exceed <em data-td-fact-id="27728162" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">ten</em> years from, the option grant date. At <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017, </em>approximately <em data-td-fact-id="27728163" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2,867,000</em> shares were available for future grant.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">All restricted stock and restricted stock units issued to date vest in equal installments over <em data-td-fact-id="27728164" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">three</em> years or cliff vest after <em data-td-fact-id="27728165" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">five</em> years. Once applicable restrictions lapse or have bee<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">n satisfied, restricted stock units <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>be payable in cash, shares of common stock or a combination, as specified in the award agreement. Awards of restricted stock or restricted stock units are generally subject to forfeiture and restrictions on transferability until vested. If restricted stock and restricted stock unit award recipients cease to perform services for the Company, all shares of common stock and restricted stock units still subject to restrictions generally will be forfeited unless waived by the Compensation Committee. Recipients of restricted stock generally will have certain rights and privileges of a stockholder, including the right to vote such shares and receive dividends, if any. Recipients of restricted stock units generally will <em data-td-fact-id="27728166" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> have the rights and privileges of a stockholder, except they <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>be entitled to receive dividend equivalents, if so specified in the award agreements and dividends are declared.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">The Compensation Committee of our Board of Directors approved grants of <em data-td-fact-id="27728167" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">35,000</em><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"> restricted stock units to our Chief Executive Officer and President (former Chief Operating Officer until <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> February 2015) </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="27728168" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">35,000</em> shares of restricted stock to our Vice Chairman and Chief Financial Officer in <em data-td-fact-id="27728169" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017.</em> Both grants are under the <em data-td-fact-id="27728170" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2013</em> Plan, are to be settled in shares of common stock, vest in equal installments over <em data-td-fact-id="27728171" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">three</em> years and are subject to reaching certain defined full year earnings targets established at the beginning of each year by the Compensation Committee. In <em data-td-fact-id="27728172" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27728173" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">31,924</em> shares of both performance-based&nbsp;restricted stock and restricted stock units vested, and <em data-td-fact-id="27728174" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">4,455</em> of both restricted stock shares and restricted stock units were forfeited. Forfeitures in any given year result from differences between our actual results for the previous year as compared to the defined full year earnings target. Once the vesting period expires, common stock is issued in settlement of the restricted stock units and all vested shares are <em data-td-fact-id="27728175" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> longer subject to forfeiture or restrictions on transferability. As of <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017, </em><em data-td-fact-id="27728176" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">66,288</em> restricted stock shares and <em data-td-fact-id="27728177" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">127,152</em> restricted stock units (both performance-based)&nbsp;were outstanding.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">In <em data-td-fact-id="27728178" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017,</em> we also granted to non-executive management employees <em data-td-fact-id="27728179" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">83,800</em> shares of restricted stock that vest in equal installments over <em data-td-fact-id="27728180" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">three</em> years, and repurchased <em data-td-fact-id="27728181" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">25,156</em> shares of common stock from such employees for <em data-td-fact-id="27728182" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$506,000</em> related to settlement of inco<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">me taxes on <em data-td-fact-id="27728183" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">75,197</em> shares that vested under the <em data-td-fact-id="27728184" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2013</em> Plan. In <em data-td-fact-id="27728185" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017,</em> we also repurchased <em data-td-fact-id="27728186" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">30,699</em> shares of common stock for <em data-td-fact-id="27728187" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$597,000</em> from executive management employees to settle income taxes on <em data-td-fact-id="27728188" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">63,848</em> performance-based&nbsp;shares that vested under the&nbsp;<em data-td-fact-id="27728189" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2013</em> Plan<b>.</b> Repurchases of common stock related to settlement of income taxes upon restricted stock vesting are reflected as financing activities in the statement of cash flows.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><b style="font-size: 10pt; text-align: left;"><em data-td-fact-id="27728190" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2008</em> Formula Restricted Stock Plan, Amended and Restated as of <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> April 17, 2012</em></b><font style="font-size: 10pt; text-align: left;"> &ndash; The <em data-td-fact-id="27728191" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2008</em> Formula Restricted Stock Plan (the <em data-td-fact-id="27728192" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2008</em> Formula Plan) expired by its terms in <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> February 2018 (</em>see the proposed New <em data-td-fact-id="27728193" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2018</em> Formula Restricted Stock Plan below).<b> </b>The <em data-td-fact-id="27728194" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2008</em> Formula Plan constituted a &ldquo;formula plan&rdquo; within the meaning of SEC Rule <em data-td-fact-id="27728195" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">16b</em>-<em data-td-fact-id="27728196" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">3</em> of the Exchange Act. Approval of the <em data-td-fact-id="27728197" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2008</em> Formula Plan, and termination of the Formula Stock Option Plan, did <em data-td-fact-id="27728198" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> adversely affect the rights of any outstanding stock options previously granted under the Formula Stock Option Plan. The <em data-td-fact-id="27728199" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2008</em> Formula Plan was administered by the Board of Directors, excluding non-employee directors.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;"><b><em data-td-fact-id="27728200" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2004</em> Stock Incentive Plan, Amended and Restated as of <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> February 10, 2009</em></b><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"> <i>&ndash;</i> The <em data-td-fact-id="27728201" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2004</em> Stock Incentive Plan (the <em data-td-fact-id="27728202" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2004</em> Plan), which provided equity-based incentives for attracting and retaining key employees, directors and others providing services to the Company, terminated by its terms in <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> February 2014 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="27728203" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> further awards can be granted under the plan. Previously granted awards under the <em data-td-fact-id="27728204" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2004</em> Plan consisted of incentive stock options, non-statutory stock options, restricted stock units or restricted stock. All stock options granted under the <em data-td-fact-id="27728205" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2004</em> Plan had an exercise price equal to the market value of the underlying common stock at grant date, expire <em data-td-fact-id="27728206" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">ten</em> years from grant date and vested immediately or in equal installments over <em data-td-fact-id="27728207" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">three</em> years, and restricted stock and restricted stock units vested <em data-td-fact-id="27728208" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">three</em> years from grant date or in equal installments over <em data-td-fact-id="27728209" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">three</em> years. Once applicable restrictions lapsed or were satisfied, restricted stock units were payable in cash, shares of common stock or a combination, as specified in the award agreement. Termination of the <em data-td-fact-id="27728210" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2004</em> Plan did <em data-td-fact-id="27728211" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> adversely affect rights under any outstanding awards previously granted under the plan and all awards granted under the <em data-td-fact-id="27728212" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2004</em> Plan have now vested.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;"><b>Formula Stock Option Plan for Directors</b><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"> &ndash; The Formula Stock Option Plan was suspended in <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 2007 </em>and terminated in <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> February 2008, </em>and the <em data-td-fact-id="27728213" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2008</em> Formula Plan described above was approved by stockholders at the <em data-td-fact-id="27728214" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2008</em> Annual Meeting. Prior to plan suspension and termination, before <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> February&nbsp;</em><em data-td-fact-id="27728215" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">1</em> each year, individual outside directors were awarded an option to purchase <em data-td-fact-id="27728216" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">10,000</em> shares of common stock at an exercise price equal to the average fair market value per share for the <em data-td-fact-id="27728217" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">ten</em>-day period prior to award. Termination of the Formula Stock Option Plan did <em data-td-fact-id="27728218" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> adversely affect rights under any outstanding stock options previously granted. All options granted under this plan generally vested in <em data-td-fact-id="27728219" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">six</em> months, and expired <em data-td-fact-id="27728220" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">ten</em> years, from grant date. </font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;"><b>Employee Stock Purchase Plan</b><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"> &ndash; The SMI Employee Stock Purchase Plan (the ESPP) is intended to provide employees the opportunity to acquire stock ownership in the Company. The authorized number of shares of common stock issuable under the ESPP is <em data-td-fact-id="27728221" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">800,000.</em> At <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017, </em>approximately <em data-td-fact-id="27728222" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">439,000</em> shares were available for future grant. Prior to each <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> January&nbsp;</em><em data-td-fact-id="27728223" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">1,</em> the Compensation Committee of the Board of Directors determines whether participating eligible employees will be granted the right to purchase shares of common stock for the upcoming calendar year and the number of shares available for purchase. All employee grants contain the same number of shares and grant date. <em data-td-fact-id="27728224" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">No</em> participant can be granted the right to purchase more than <em data-td-fact-id="27728225" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">500</em> shares in any calendar year. The stock purchase price is <em data-td-fact-id="27728226" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">90%</em> of the lesser of fair market value at grant date or exercise date. Unexercised grants expire at each calendar year end. <em data-td-fact-id="27728227" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">No</em> shares were granted to employees under the ESPP for calendar years <em data-td-fact-id="27728228" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27728229" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> or <em data-td-fact-id="27728230" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015.</em></font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;"><b>Share-Based Payment</b><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"> &ndash; We follow applicable authoritative guidance which generally requires recognizing compensation cost for the estimated grant-date fair value of stock options and other equity-based compensation over the requisite service period, and applies to all awards granted, modified, vesting, repurchased or cancelled after <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> January&nbsp;</em><em data-td-fact-id="27728231" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">1,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27728232" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2006.</em> We generally record share-based compensation cost for stock option, restricted stock and restricted stock unit awards on either the accelerated method using a graded vesting schedule or the straight-line method over the requisite service period, depending on the vesting schedule of the awards. Our practice has been to issue new shares upon option exercise; however, repurchases of shares in the open market are permitted.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">&nbsp;<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"> &nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">Share-based compensation cost totaled <em data-td-fact-id="27728233" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$3,366,000</em> in <em data-td-fact-id="27728234" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27728235" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$3,405,000</em> in <em data-td-fact-id="27728236" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27728237" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$3,383,000</em> in <em data-td-fact-id="27728238" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015,</em> before <font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">income taxes of <em data-td-fact-id="27728239" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$1,251,000,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27728240" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$1,205,000</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27728241" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$1,272,000,</em> respectively, and is included in general and administrative expense. There were <em data-td-fact-id="27728242" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> capitalized share-based compensation costs at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017 </em>or <em data-td-fact-id="27728243" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016.</em> As of <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017, </em>there was approximately <em data-td-fact-id="27728244" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$3,889,000</em> of total unrecognized compensation cost related to non-vested restricted stock and restricted stock units granted under the <em data-td-fact-id="27728245" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2013</em> Plan and the <em data-td-fact-id="27728246" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2008</em> Formula Plan that is expected to be recognized over a weighted average period of <em data-td-fact-id="27728247" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">1.0</em> year.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;"><em data-td-fact-id="27728248" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">No</em> stock option<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">s were granted under any of our stock compensation plans in <em data-td-fact-id="27728249" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27728250" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> or <em data-td-fact-id="27728251" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015.</em> When stock options are granted, we estimate the fair value of stock option grants on grant date using the Black-Scholes option-pricing model based on the following factors and assumptions. Expected volatility is based on implied volatilities from historical volatility of our stock and other factors. We use historical data to estimate option exercises, forfeitures and employee terminations within the pricing model. Employee groups have similar historical exercise experience and are combined for valuation purposes. The expected term of granted options is estimated based on historical exercise experience and represents the time period that granted options are expected to be outstanding. Risk-free interest rates for periods within the expected life of options are based on the US Treasury yield curve in effect at the time of grant.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"> &nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">There were <em data-td-fact-id="27728252" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> significant changes in the characteristics of restricted stock or restricted stock unit<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">s granted during <em data-td-fact-id="27728253" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015</em> through <em data-td-fact-id="27728254" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> as compared to prior grants and <em data-td-fact-id="27728255" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> modifications of the terms of any share-based payment arrangements. There were <em data-td-fact-id="27728256" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> significant changes in estimates, assumptions or valuation methods used to estimate the fair value of share-based payment awards. We believe the pricing model and approach utilized to develop the underlying assumptions are appropriate for estimating the fair values of share-based awards. These fair value and other estimates are <em data-td-fact-id="27728257" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> intended to predict future events or value ultimately realizable by employees who receive equity awards, and subsequent events are <em data-td-fact-id="27728258" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> indicative of the reasonableness of original estimates.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;"><em data-td-fact-id="27728259" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">No</em> stock options have been granted under the <em data-td-fact-id="27728260" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2013</em> Plan. The following is a summary of stoc<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">k option activity regarding the <em data-td-fact-id="27728261" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2004</em> Plan and Formula Stock Option Plan for <em data-td-fact-id="27728262" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> (shares and aggregate intrinsic value in thousands):</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">As of <font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"><em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017, </em>all stock options were vested and there was <em data-td-fact-id="27728263" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> unrecognized compensation cost related to non-vested stock options granted under any of our stock compensation plans. Outstanding and exercisable stock options with <em data-td-fact-id="27728264" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> intrinsic value as of <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017 </em>are excluded from the aggregate intrinsic values presented above. <em data-td-fact-id="27728265" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">No</em> stock options vested in <em data-td-fact-id="27728266" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27728267" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> or <em data-td-fact-id="27728268" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015.</em> In <em data-td-fact-id="27728269" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27728270" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27728271" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27728272" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">40,500,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27728273" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">11,500</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27728274" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">55,500</em> stock options were exercised with an intrinsic value of <em data-td-fact-id="27728275" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$199,000,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27728276" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$48,000</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27728277" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$327,000,</em> respectively.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><b>New <em data-td-fact-id="27728293" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2018</em> Formula Restricted Stock Plan</b><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"><i> </i>&ndash; The <em data-td-fact-id="27728294" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2008</em> Formula Plan expired by its terms in <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> February 2018. </em>In <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> March 2018, </em>our Board of Directors adopted a new <em data-td-fact-id="27728295" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2018</em> Formula Restricted Stock Plan (the <em data-td-fact-id="27728296" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2018</em> Formula Plan) subject to stockholder approval at our <em data-td-fact-id="27728297" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2018</em> Annual Meeting. The proposed <em data-td-fact-id="27728298" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2018</em> Formula Plan is intended to promote the interests of the Company and its stockholders by providing non-employee directors with Company ownership interests to more closely align their interests with our stockholders and enhance our ability to attract and retain highly qualified non-employee directors. The <em data-td-fact-id="27728299" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2018</em> Formula Plan is intended to constitute a &ldquo;formula plan&rdquo; within the meaning of SEC Rule <em data-td-fact-id="27728300" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">16b</em>-<em data-td-fact-id="27728301" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">3</em> of the Exchange Act. Approval of the <em data-td-fact-id="27728302" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2018</em> Formula Plan, and expiration of the <em data-td-fact-id="27728303" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2008</em> Formula Plan, will <em data-td-fact-id="27728304" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> adversely affect the rights of any outstanding awards previously granted under the <em data-td-fact-id="27728305" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2008</em> Formula Plan. The <em data-td-fact-id="27728306" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2018</em> Formula Plan will be administered by the Board of Directors, excluding non-employee directors, who can amend, suspend or terminate the plan in whole or in part, provided that <em data-td-fact-id="27728307" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> such amendment, suspension or termination adversely affects previously granted awards without the consent of the award recipient. Any such amendment, suspension or termination <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>be subject to stockholder approval. </font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">Under the <font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">proposed <em data-td-fact-id="27728308" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2018</em> Formula Plan, <em data-td-fact-id="27728309" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">250,000</em> shares of SMI&rsquo;s common stock will be reserved for issuance and awards will be in the form of restricted stock. On the <em data-td-fact-id="27728310" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">first</em> business day following each annual meeting, each standing non-employee director will receive a grant of restricted stock consisting of the number of shares equaling <em data-td-fact-id="27728311" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$75,000</em> divided by the average closing sale price for the <em data-td-fact-id="27728312" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">twenty</em> days immediately preceding the grant date. Grants of restricted stock fully vest on the earlier of (i)&nbsp;the <em data-td-fact-id="27728313" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">first</em> grant date anniversary or (ii)&nbsp;the day before our next annual meeting following the grant date. Vesting is subject to continued service as a director through scheduled vesting dates. These terms and conditions are similar to those of the expired <em data-td-fact-id="27728314" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2008</em> Formula Plan.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">The Speedway Motorsports, Inc. <em data-td-fact-id="27728316" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">401</em>(k) Plan and Trust is available to our employees who meet certain eligibility requirements. The Plan allows participants to elect contributions of up to <em data-td-fact-id="27728317" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">75%</em> of their annual compensation within certain prescribed limits, o<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">f which the Company will match <em data-td-fact-id="27728318" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">25%</em> of the <em data-td-fact-id="27728319" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">first</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27728320" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">4%</em> of employee contributions. Participants become fully vested in Company matching contributions over <em data-td-fact-id="27728321" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">six</em> years. Our contributions for the Plan were <em data-td-fact-id="27728322" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$423,000</em> in <em data-td-fact-id="27728323" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="27728324" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$406,000</em> in <em data-td-fact-id="27728325" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27728326" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$379,000</em> in <em data-td-fact-id="27728327" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015.</em></font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">T<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">he Speedway Motorsports, Inc. Deferred Compensation Plan is available to all our employees who meet eligibility requirements. This plan allows participants to elect to defer up to <em data-td-fact-id="27728328" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">75%</em> of their base salary and <em data-td-fact-id="27728329" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">100%</em> of their annual bonus and other cash compensation, if any, as permitted by the Plan Administrator. Participants can designate <em data-td-fact-id="27728330" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">one</em> or more investments as the measure of investment return on their participant account, and can elect distributions in lump sum or specified periodic installments. We hold assets consisting principally of Company-owned life insurance (COLI) policies on certain plan participants for funding future participant distributions. Those are general assets of the Company subject to claims of creditors or unsecured claims. Our obligation to pay amounts deferred under this plan is impacted by rates of returns on investments selected by plan participants, is an unsecured obligation and <em data-td-fact-id="27728331" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> subject to forfeiture. Our common stock is <em data-td-fact-id="27728332" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> an investment option or plan asset. The COLI&rsquo;s carrying value of <em data-td-fact-id="27728333" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$4,008,000</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27728334" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$3,336,000</em> is reflected in non-current Other Assets and the associated deferred compensation liability of <em data-td-fact-id="27728335" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$3,912,000</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27728336" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$3,241,000</em>&nbsp;is reflected in non-current Other Liabilities at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="27728337" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016,</em> respectively, and associated earnings, losses or other changes are reflected in general and administrative expense.&nbsp;Participants are fully vested in their contributions and associated earnings or losses credited to their individual accounts. We <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>make discretionary contributions for any <em data-td-fact-id="27728338" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">one</em> or all eligible employees which, if any, shall be <em data-td-fact-id="27728339" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">100%</em> vested following <em data-td-fact-id="27728340" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">three</em> years of service once <em data-td-fact-id="27728341" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">first</em> eligible to participate in this plan. There were <em data-td-fact-id="27728342" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> Company contributions in <em data-td-fact-id="27728343" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015</em> through <em data-td-fact-id="27728344" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017.</em></font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">Our operations are predominately comprised of promoting, marketing and sponsoring motorsports racing events, merchandising and other related activities conducted at our various major <font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">speedway facilities located in the United States. Our business activities, including those of our subsidiaries, are further described in Notes&nbsp;<em data-td-fact-id="27728346" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">1</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="27728347" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2.</em> All Company assets are located in the United States. Our &ldquo;motorsports event related&rdquo; segment consists of revenues and expenses associated with all admissions, event related, NASCAR broadcasting and event motorsports merchandising activities. The segment includes motorsports related events and operations for all Company speedways, NASCAR broadcasting and ancillary media rights, PRN and RCU motorsports radio programming, and SMI Properties and SMI Trackside motorsports merchandising at Company and non-Company speedways. These operating segments have been aggregated into the motorsports related reportable segment as each share similar types and classes of customers, similar methods for providing or distributing motorsports related services, souvenirs and other merchandise, and other similar economic characteristics. Our &ldquo;all other&rdquo; operations consist of SMIP subsidiary non-event motorsports and non-motorsports merchandising, Legend Cars non-event merchandising and sanctioning body activities, Oil-Chem micro-lubricant activities, TMS natural gas mineral rights lease and related revenues, and office rentals at certain Company speedways. Our &ldquo;all other&rdquo; operations for <em data-td-fact-id="27728348" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> also consists of revenues and direct expenses associated with &ldquo;the Battle at Bristol&rdquo; and a large preceding concert as further discussed in Note <em data-td-fact-id="27728349" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">1.</em> Management believes reporting these results separate from our core business of &ldquo;motorsports event related&rdquo; operations is appropriate as <em data-td-fact-id="27728350" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> additional football games are scheduled at this time (nor have any been held before).</font></p>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

			<p style="margin: 0pt 1.6pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b>CONTROLS AND PROCEDURES</b></p>
